# @Generated by scripts/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_trade_league_effects.py
#   Data:    data/trade_league_goods.yaml
#   Regen:   conda run --no-capture-output -n eu5 python scripts/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_trade_league_effects.py
# Do not edit directly - modify the data file and re-run the generator.

tv_trade_league_create_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_founder
	if = {
		limit = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_league_member }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
			}
		}
		create_international_organization = {
			type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = prev
				set_leader_country = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_update_monopolies_effect = {
	# horses
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_horses value = "produced_in_world:horses" }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_horses value = var:tv_trade_global_horses }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_trade = {
			limit = { goods = goods:horses }
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_horses value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_horses value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_horses > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses value = var:tv_trade_io_horses }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses divide = var:tv_trade_global_horses }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_horses value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses divide = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_horses value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_horses divide = 2 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_horses >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_horses value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_horses value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_horses divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_horses >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_horses ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_horses ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:horses amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_horses }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_horses >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_horses ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_horses ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_horses
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_iron value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_iron }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_iron divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_iron }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_iron }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_iron >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_iron ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_iron scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_iron months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_iron >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_iron ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:iron amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_iron }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_iron >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_iron ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_iron ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_iron
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tin > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tin value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tin value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tin }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tin divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tin value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tin }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tin divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tin >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tin >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tin >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tin value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tin value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tin divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tin value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tin }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tin subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tin }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tin < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tin value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_tin >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tin >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tin ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_tin scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tin months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tin >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_tin ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:tin amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tin }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tin >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_tin ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_tin ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_tin
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# lead

		every_trade = {

			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}

			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_tea value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_tea value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_tea > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea value = var:tv_trade_io_tea }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea divide = var:tv_trade_global_tea }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_tea value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tea value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_tea }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tea multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tea > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tea value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tea value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tea }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tea divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tea value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tea divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tea >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tea }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tea >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tea value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tea value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tea divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tea }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tea }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tea >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tea ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_tea scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tea months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_tea ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:tea amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tea }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tea >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_tea ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_tea ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_tea
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	}

					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_ivory scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_ivory months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_ivory >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_ivory ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:ivory amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_ivory }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_ivory >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_ivory ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_ivory ?= {

		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pearls >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_pearls add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pearls }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_pearls >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_pearls add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_pearls }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_pearls >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_pearls value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_pearls add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pearls value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_pearls }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pearls divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_pearls }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_pearls }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_pearls >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pearls >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_pearls ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_pearls scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_pearls months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_pearls >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_pearls ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:pearls amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_pearls }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_pearls >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_pearls ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_pearls ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_pearls
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_elephants value = var:tv_trade_io_elephants }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_elephants divide = var:tv_trade_global_elephants }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_elephants >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_elephants value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_elephants add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_elephants value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_elephants }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_elephants multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_elephants > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_elephants value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_elephants value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_elephants }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_elephants divide = 5 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_elephants value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_elephants }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_elephants divide = 5 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_elephants >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_elephants }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_elephants >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_elephants }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_elephants >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_elephants value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_elephants value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_elephants divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_elephants }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_elephants }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_elephants >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_elephants >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_elephants ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_elephants scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_elephants months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_elephants >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_elephants ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:elephants amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_elephants }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_elephants >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_elephants ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_elephants ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_elephants
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_pepper ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:pepper amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_pepper }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_pepper >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_pepper ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_pepper ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_pepper
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_cloves > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves value = var:tv_trade_io_cloves }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves divide = var:tv_trade_global_cloves }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_cloves value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cloves value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cloves }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cloves multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cloves > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cloves value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cloves value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cloves }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cloves divide = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cloves value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cloves }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cloves divide = 0.5 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cloves >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cloves }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cloves >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cloves }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_cloves >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_cloves value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_cloves value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_cloves divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cloves }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cloves }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves >= 1 }

			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cloves >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_cloves ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_cloves scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cloves months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cloves >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_cloves ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:cloves amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cloves }
				}
			}
		}

		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tobacco >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tobacco value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tobacco value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_tobacco divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_tobacco >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tobacco >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tobacco ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_tobacco scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tobacco months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tobacco >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_tobacco ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:tobacco amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tobacco }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tobacco >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_tobacco ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_tobacco ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_tobacco
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_cannons > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cannons value = var:tv_trade_io_cannons }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cannons divide = var:tv_trade_global_cannons }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cannons >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_cannons value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_cannons add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cannons value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_cannons }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cannons multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cannons > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cannons value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cannons value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cannons }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cannons divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cannons value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cannons }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cannons divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cannons >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cannons }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cannons >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cannons }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_cannons >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_cannons value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_cannons value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_cannons divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_cannons }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_cannons }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_cannons >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cannons >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_cannons ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_cannons scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cannons months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cannons >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_cannons ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:cannons amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cannons }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_cannons >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_cannons ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_cannons ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_cannons
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_cloth >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_cloth ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_cloth ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_cloth
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_books }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_books }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_books >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_books >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_books ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_books scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_books months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_books >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_books ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:books amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_books }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_books >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_books ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_books ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_books
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_lacquerware value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_lacquerware }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_lacquerware multiply = 100 }

		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_lacquerware > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_lacquerware value = 100 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_lacquerware value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_lacquerware }

			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_wild_game ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_wild_game ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_wild_game
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# fur
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_fur value = "produced_in_world:fur" }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_fur value = var:tv_trade_global_fur }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_trade = {
			limit = { goods = goods:fur }
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_fur value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fur value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_fur > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur value = var:tv_trade_io_fur }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur divide = var:tv_trade_global_fur }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fur value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fur value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fur }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fur multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fur > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fur value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fur value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fur }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fur divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fur value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fur }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fur divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fur >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fur }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fur >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fur }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_fur >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_fur value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_fur value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_fur divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fur }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fur }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_fur >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fur >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_fur ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_fur scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fur months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fur >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_fur ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:fur amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fur }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_fur >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_fur ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_fur ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_fur
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_rice >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_rice >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_rice ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_rice scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_rice months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_rice >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_rice ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:rice amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_rice }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_rice >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_rice ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_rice ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_rice
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# millet

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_millet value = "produced_in_world:millet" }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_millet value = var:tv_trade_global_millet }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_trade = {
			limit = { goods = goods:millet }
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_millet value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_millet value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_millet > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet value = var:tv_trade_io_millet }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet divide = var:tv_trade_global_millet }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_millet value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_millet value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_millet }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_millet multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_millet > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_millet value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_millet value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_millet }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_millet divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_millet value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_millet }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_millet divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_millet >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_millet }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_millet >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_millet }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_millet >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_millet value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_millet value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_millet divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_millet }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_millet }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet value = 0 }
	}

				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_millet >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_millet ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:millet amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_millet }
				}
			}

		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_olives add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_olives }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_olives >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_olives add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_olives }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_olives >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_olives value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_olives add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_olives value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_olives }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_olives divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_olives }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_olives }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_olives >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_olives ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_olives scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_olives months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_olives >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_olives ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:olives amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_olives }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_olives >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_olives ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_olives ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_olives
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# fruit
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_fruit value = "produced_in_world:fruit" }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_fruit value = var:tv_trade_global_fruit }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_trade = {
			limit = { goods = goods:fruit }
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = trade_volume }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_fruit value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fruit value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_fruit > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit value = var:tv_trade_io_fruit }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit divide = var:tv_trade_global_fruit }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fruit value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fruit value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fruit }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fruit multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fruit > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fruit value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fruit value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fruit }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fruit divide = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fruit value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fruit }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fruit divide = 2 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fruit >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fruit }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fruit >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fruit }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_fruit >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_fruit value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_fruit value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_fruit divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fruit value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_fruit }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fruit subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_fruit }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fruit < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fruit value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_fruit >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fruit >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_fruit ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_fruit scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fruit months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fruit >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_fruit ?= {
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:fruit amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fruit }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_fruit >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_fruit ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_fruit ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_fruit
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax >= 1 }

			limit = { goods = goods:slaves_goods }

		}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_slaves_goods value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_slaves_goods > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_io_slaves_goods }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods divide = var:tv_trade_global_slaves_goods }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods >= 0.51 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods multiply = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 100 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_slaves_goods divide = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods divide = 1 }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_slaves_goods value = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = 10 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_slaves_goods divide = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1 }

			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_slaves_goods ?= {
				market = {
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_slaves_goods scale = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_slaves_goods months = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }

					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:slaves_goods amount = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods }

				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_slaves_goods ?= {

							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_slaves_goods
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}

		}
